title: Mirror the coordinator's final-diff audit for authority-text landings into TermAl's instruction files, citing Engram 778e596
outcome: TermAl's CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .claude/commands/review-changes.md carry the final-diff audit as condition (c) of the authority-text rule, in the wording both coordinators concurred on, so a landing of authority text cannot contain a passage nobody agreed to word for word.
acceptance: A test in the agent-command tests pins the new review-changes.md paragraph, and the test that compares CLAUDE.md with AGENTS.md, where one exists, still passes.

Every sentence added or changed in CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .claude/commands/review-changes.md is quoted whole in a recorded message, and both coordinators' concurrence on that exact wording is recorded on this item before the landing; the item's notes map each changed passage to its message.
Greg was sent the exact wording and its consequence before the landing, and the item records when and where; no objection from him is recorded.

The final frozen diff was audited against the recorded sentences by the other project's coordinator, since TermAl's coordinator wrote the change, and by script (whitespace-normalised exact strings and a word-level diff); the audit's result is recorded on the item before the landing.

The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, and the review pair has no outstanding finding that blocks under the rule in force when the pair ran; each unfixed Low is filed as its own item.
